home-content.features-sub: We believe exceptional bread starts with premium ingredients, patient fermentation, and a commitment to freshness.
home-content.feature-ai-text: Self-documenting code, llms.txt, Schema.org and WebMCP - so coding agents and search engines instantly get your site.
home-content.feature-speed-text: Astro ships zero JavaScript unless you need it. Perfect Lighthouse scores are the starting line, not the goal.
home-content.feature-theme-text: One config file drives colors, fonts, light/dark mode and branding. Make it yours before your coffee gets cold.
home-content.feature-i18n-text: First-class i18n with locale-aware routing, hreflang and translated content collections baked right in.
home-content.feature-content-text: Blog, events, FAQ and docs come pre-built with typed content collections. Write markdown, ship pages.
home-content.feature-dx-text: TypeScript everywhere, TailwindCSS, ESLint and Prettier pre-wired, and a Cloudflare Worker ready to deploy.
home-content.voices-sub: A few notes from the people who keep coming back for more bread.
home-content.voice-1-quote: The loaves are beautiful, fragrant, and so deeply satisfying. It feels like a small luxury every time.
home-content.voice-2-quote: You can taste the care in every slice. The sourdough is thoughtful, balanced, and always fresh.
home-content.voice-3-quote: The seasonal bakes are always a highlight. Everything feels intentional and beautifully made.
home-content.voice-4-quote: It is rare to find bread that feels both rustic and refined. This bakery gets it exactly right.
home-content.usecases-heading: Fresh bread for breakfasts, gatherings, and everything in between
home-content.usecases-sub: Whether it is a Sunday loaf, a dinner table centerpiece, or a gift for someone special, we bake with care.
home-content.usecase-weekend-text: Fresh loaves and pastries for slower mornings, cozy tables, and thoughtful hosting.
home-content.usecase-gifts-text: Beautiful breads and seasonal treats make memorable gifts for neighbors, hosts, and celebrations.
home-content.usecase-table-text: Bring a loaf to the table and let the crust, aroma, and flavor speak for themselves.
home-content.usecase-events-text: From intimate gatherings to celebratory spreads, our bakes are made to belong.
home-content.parallax-eyebrow: A small bakery with a big point of view
home-content.parallax-heading: Bread made with patience, craft, and care
home-content.cta-sub: Stay connected for current bakes, pickup windows, and special seasonal releases.
home-content.howitworks-sub: A simple weekly rhythm built around freshness and convenience.
home-content.step-menu-text: We share the week’s loaves and bakes by text, straight to your phone.
home-content.step-signup-text: Join the bread list to receive the menu automatically every Sunday.
home-content.step-order-text: Reply or order online by Tuesday. Let us know what sounds good.
home-content.step-pickup-text: We bake fresh that morning. Your order is ready for pickup.
home-content.loaves-sub: Naturally leavened, slow-fermented, and baked fresh with premium ingredients.
home-content.menu-sub: A new menu drops every Sunday. Browse the PDF to see the week's loaves and seasonal bakes.
home-content.loaf-sourdough-text: Our signature naturally fermented loaf with a crisp crust, open crumb, and balanced tang.
home-content.loaf-country-text: A rustic blend of bread and whole wheat flours with a hearty texture and deep flavor.
home-content.loaf-batard-text: An elegant oval loaf with a golden crust and soft, airy crumb — perfect for every table.
home-content.loaf-seeded-text: Encrusted with sesame, sunflower, and pumpkin seeds for a nutty, wholesome bite.
home-content.feature-bread-text: Naturally fermented loaves with a crisp crust, open crumb, and a rich, balanced flavor.
home-content.feature-ferment-text: Every loaf is given the time it needs to develop flavor, aroma, and character.
home-content.feature-seasonal-text: We rotate our offerings with the seasons, bringing in thoughtful ingredients and special flavors.
home-content.feature-local-text: Our bakery is anchored in Michigan and shaped by the rhythms of the local season.
home-content.feature-ordering-text: Loaves and pastries are baked to be enjoyed at peak freshness, often available for same-day pickup.
home-content.feature-gatherings-text: From weekend tables to thoughtful gifts, our bakes are made to bring people together.
home-content.usecase-weekend-text: Fresh loaves and pastries for slower mornings, cozy tables, and thoughtful hosting.
home-content.usecase-gifts-text: Beautiful breads and seasonal treats make memorable gifts for neighbors, hosts, and celebrations.
home-content.usecase-table-text: Bring a loaf to the table and let the crust, aroma, and flavor speak for themselves.
home-content.usecase-events-text: From intimate gatherings to celebratory spreads, our bakes are made to belong.

features-content.stardrive-sub: We combine premium ingredients, long fermentation, and a close eye for freshness to create loaves that feel elevated and grounded.
features-content.astro-sub: Every bake begins with care, patience, and respect for the ingredients that make the crumb and crust shine.
features-content.llm-friendly-tagline: Premium flour, good butter, and careful sourcing.
features-content.llm-friendly-detail: We choose ingredients that bring depth, structure, and flavor to every loaf and pastry.
features-content.webmcp-tagline: Flavor develops with time and patience.
features-content.webmcp-detail: Our dough is given room to mature, creating loaves with character, aroma, and lasting texture.
features-content.llms-txt-tagline: Baked for peak flavor and enjoyment.
features-content.llms-txt-detail: We aim to have each loaf reach your table at its best, with the aroma and texture that make it unforgettable.
features-content.schema-org-tagline: Thoughtful bakes that change with the season.
features-content.schema-org-detail: Our menu evolves with the season, featuring ingredients and flavors that feel timely and special.
features-content.typed-detail: Each step is guided by attention, consistency, and a respect for the bread itself.
features-content.tailwind-tagline: A crust that sings and a crumb that delights.
features-content.tailwind-detail: From the crackle of the crust to the softness inside, every loaf is made to be enjoyed deeply.
features-content.lint-format-detail: We keep our process steady so each bake delivers the same dependable quality and flavor.
features-content.package-manager-tagline: Order around your week and your schedule.
features-content.package-manager-detail: We make it easy to plan for fresh bread and seasonal bakes with simple pickup options.
features-content.central-config-tagline: A bakery built around craft and care.
features-content.central-config-detail: Everything we make reflects the same priorities: quality ingredients, freshness, and thoughtful flavor.
features-content.cloudflare-tagline: Baked in limited runs, made to be treasured.
features-content.cloudflare-detail: We work in small batches so each loaf stays fresh, flavorful, and beautifully made.
features-content.hot-theme-tagline: A bakery experience that feels personal.
features-content.hot-theme-detail: From the first loaf to the last slice, our goal is to make each bake feel special.
features-content.light-dark-tagline: Available in the moment, not the distant future.
features-content.light-dark-detail: We bake for the day, so freshness and timing are part of the experience itself.
features-content.i18n-detail: We are proud to bring our artisan breads and seasonal bakes to the Michigan community.
features-content.transitions-tagline: A bakery experience that feels easy and elegant.
features-content.transitions-detail: Our bakes, service, and presentation all reflect a calm confidence and refined approach.
features-content.dynamic-header-tagline: The menu changes with the season and the oven.
features-content.dynamic-header-detail: From sourdough classics to special seasonal offerings, our bakery menu evolves with care.
features-content.references-tagline: A community that keeps coming back.
features-content.references-detail: We are proud to be part of a neighborhood that values quality bread, shared tables, and thoughtful craft.
features-content.pricing-tables-tagline: Pickup, special orders, and seasonal releases.
features-content.pricing-tables-detail: Whether you want a weekly loaf or a custom order for an event, we make it easy to plan around fresh bread.
features-content.promo-tagline: Bakes, releases, and fresh news on demand.
features-content.promo-detail: Our bakery updates keep you close to the next loaf, pastry drop, or special seasonal item.
features-content.blog-tagline: Stories, process, and the joy of baking.
features-content.blog-detail: We share the thinking behind our breads, ingredients, and seasonal bakes so you can feel close to the craft.
features-content.events-detail: From weekly bakes to special releases, our bakery calendar is full of reasons to stop by.
features-content.faq-detail: We are happy to answer questions about availability, ingredients, and what is baking this week.
features-content.wcag-tagline: An experience that is easy to understand.
features-content.wcag-detail: We keep our bakery messaging warm, clear, and accessible so every visitor feels comfortable stepping in.
features-content.tiny-tweaks-tagline: The small touches that make bread feel special.
features-content.tiny-tweaks-detail: Every bake is shaped by details of texture, aroma, timing, and presentation.
features-content.lighthouse-detail: We care most about the quality of the bake, then the experience around it.
features-content.islands-tagline: Every loaf is made with care and attention.
features-content.islands-detail: Our bakery favors craft and patience over shortcuts, allowing each loaf to develop real character.
features-content.zero-js-detail: We keep the experience straightforward so the bread and bakery story remain front and center.
features-content.content-collections-tagline: A baking calendar shaped by the season.
features-content.content-collections-detail: We gather our stories, schedules, and offerings in a way that feels warm and easy to follow.
features-content.ssr-detail: Our offerings shift with the day and the season so you always know what is fresh right now.
features-content.framework-agnostic-detail: We are proud to serve neighbors and visitors with breads that feel both timeless and local.
features-content.view-transitions-detail: From the first glance to the final slice, every part of the experience is shaped to feel inviting.
features-content.image-optimization-tagline: Crust, crumb, and color captured with care.
features-content.image-optimization-detail: We care about how every loaf looks and feels, from the first photo to the first bite.
features-content.vite-detail: We work carefully and intentionally so every bake feels worthy of the pause and the table.
